editorial:
A married couple on the edge of divorce gets stranded at a creepy, run-down motel in the middle of nowhere. They check into a room that looks like it hasn't been updated since the 1970s, and things quickly go from bad to worse. They find hidden video cameras in the room and realize the motel is actually a trap. Someone is filming guests being murdered for snuff films. The whole movie has a tense, tight feel that keeps you on edge the entire time.

Luke Wilson and Kate Beckinsale do a great job playing a couple who can barely stand each other but have to work together to survive. The pacing is fast and never lets up, which is great if you want a quick, intense watch. On the downside, the story is pretty simple and doesn't have many surprises. Some of the villains feel a bit generic. Still, if you love tight, no-nonsense thrillers that get straight to the point, this one delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the couple manages to fight back against the masked killers and the motel manager who runs the snuff operation. They escape the motel after a brutal struggle, and the manager is killed. The police arrive, and the couple survives, though shaken. The twist is that the motel was a front for a murder-for-profit ring, and the manager was the mastermind behind it all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tight, no-nonsense thrillers that get straight to the point.
